title: This $40 AI tool could turn your side-hustle idea into an actual app
excerpt: Build for iOS, Android, and the web without coding.
content_html:
TL;DR: Swiftspeed AI App Builder helps you create iOS, Android, and web apps without coding, and three years of Pro access is on sale for $39.99 (reg. $432).

Credit: Swiftspeed AI

$39.99
$432 Save $392.01

Ever since the rise of smartphones, there has always been “an app for that,” which also usually means “a developer is required for that.” But thanks to AI, you can now get surprisingly far into app development without knowing what a curly brace does. Swiftspeed AI App Builder uses AI and visual editing tools to help you create iOS, Android, and web apps, with three years of Pro access currently on sale for $39.99 (reg. $432).

You can start by describing what you want to build, and Swiftspeed generates the foundation for you. From there, its drag-and-drop editor lets you customize layouts, forms, workflows, databases, and other elements without suddenly needing to become a software engineer.

If you already have an existing website, you don’t necessarily have to start over to turn it into an app. Swiftspeed can turn existing websites, WordPress sites, WooCommerce stores, and Shopify stores into apps, making this particularly useful for small businesses that already have an online presence but want somewhere to live on their customers’ home screens.

One Swiftspeed project can become an Android app, an iOS app, and a progressive web app (PWA), so you don’t have to build separate versions from scratch. The Pro Plan also includes the files and source code for your Android and iOS apps, with the iOS version ready for testing via Apple’s TestFlight.

There’s plenty to add once you’ve built the basics, too. Stripe and PayPal integrations can handle payments, while in-app purchases and AdMob support provide monetization options. You can also add push notifications, analytics, an app wallet, audio and video content, RSS feeds, quizzes, and custom pages.

AI doesn’t stop at generating the initial app, either. Swiftspeed supports chatbot functionality using providers including OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and DeepSeek, so you can incorporate AI features depending on what you’re building.

The Pro Plan covers one app and three seats, with 5GB of storage, 300 monthly push notifications, AI agent credits, priority support, and no Swiftspeed branding.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

While Swiftspeed can create the files needed to publish your app, it doesn’t eliminate Apple and Google’s requirements. You’ll still need your own Apple Developer or Google Play Developer account, pay any applicable developer fees, prepare your store listing materials, and submit the app for approval yourself.

Normally $432, you can grab a 3-year subscription to Swiftspeed AI for only $39.99.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
